, in this letter, we propose an uplink multi-user channel estimation scheme based on distributed compressive sensing (DCS) for mmWave massive multi-input multi-output (MIMO) systems over frequency selective fading channels.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can achieve good channel estimation performance with a much lower overhead than that of the conventional schemes.
, with the proposed algorithm, the channel estimation performance can be improved by 10 dB in terms of mean square error (MSE) and 3 dB in terms of signal to noise ratio (SNR).
the grid matching pursuit (GMP) algorithm with an adaptive measurement matrix (AMM) can solve the power leak problem caused by continuous AoAs and AoDs in mmWave massive MIMOs with FSF channels.
